description: ProdVerity is a read-only production verification plugin for developers and operators. It checks whether a public HTTPS web app is reachable, inspects common security headers, discovers an optional ProdVerity verification manifest, runs deterministic public health checks, and can compare a public build marker with an expected commit or release identifier. It does not log in, modify target applications, access private networks, or claim visual verification.
